coverageNote: Audited all 52 current Markdown source files in the nine logical units under .memory/wiki/specs/ideation/11-music-licensing/. Every file underwent 3a implementer simulation, 3b Vision Rubric scoring, and 3c devil's-advocate probing. Structural checks found all required index/CX files, populated Role Matrices, Role Lenses, and Edge Cases sections; no audit, remediation, decision-queue, or gate path was read.

findings.claim: All 129 active Open Questions are routed to a future workflow stage but none has a resolution deadline. A routing target is not a deadline, so the required owner + deadline + blocked-decision record is incomplete.
